{{Quote|Not far from here, there's a bunker in the hands of Gamorrean raiders. Brutish deadly creatures, responsible for the massacre at the Vactooine mining colony.|Zola Arvannus|<ref name="TOR:DC">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Desert Conquest|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The '''Vactooine mining colony''' was a mining colony on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vactooine]] that was wiped out by [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] raiders during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR:DC" />
